work.author: ACTA GREGORII PP. XVI.
work.description: Allocution CCXLIX, delivered in secret consistory (own dated caption HABITA IN CONSISTORIO SECRETO DIE VIGESIMA NONA IULII ANNO ... TRIGESIMO TERTIO, LF43051–43053, retained), addresses the cardinals (LF43056), praises Patriarch Jacopo Monico of Venice and Archbishop Filippo Giudice Caracciolo of Naples, and ends with Quid vobis videtur?, the creation formula and In nomine Patris ... Amen at LF43135–43151, before numeral CCL at LF43154. Issuer evidence is ACTA GREGORII PP. XVI. at LF43062–43062; the source closing at LF43051–43053 reads: HABITA IN CONSISTORIO SECRETO DIE, VIGESIMA NONA IULII ANNO MILLESIMO OCTINGENTESIMO TRIGESIMO TERTIO, The allocution has no sub annulo dating clause; its date is taken from its own retained caption LF43051–43053. The edition numeral, synopsis and genre label ALLOCUTIO (LF43039–43048) are excluded. Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
